business_summary: Sutro Biopharma, Inc. operates as an oncology company. The company develops site-specific and novel-format antibody drug conjugates (ADCs) that enables its proprietary integrated cell-free protein synthesis platform, XpressCF; and site-specific conjugation platform, XpressCF+. Its lead product candidate includes STRO-004, a tissue factor (TF) targeting ADC for the treatment of TF-expressing solid tumors, including non-small cell lung cancer, head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, cervical cancer, colorectal cancer, pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, endometrial cancer, and bladder cancer. The company also develops VAX-24 and Vax-31 pneumococcal conjugate vaccine candidates that is in Phase II/III clinical trials for the treatment of invasive pneumococcal disease in adults and adults and infants; and STRO-003, an ADC directed against an anti-receptor tyrosine kinase-like orphan receptor 1 (ROR1) for the treatment of solid tumors, such as triple negative breast cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, and ovarian cancer, as well as hematological cancers. Sutro Biopharma, Inc. has collaboration and license agreements with Vaxcyte to discover and develop vaccine candidates for the treatment or prophylaxis of infectious diseases; Tasly Biopharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. to develop and commercialize STRO-002 in Greater China; Ipsen to develop and commercialize STRO-003, an ADC targeting ROR1; and Astellas Pharma Inc. to develop immunostimulatory ADC. The company was formerly known as Fundamental Applied Biology, Inc. Sutro Biopharma, Inc. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, California.
business_summary_ko: Sutro Biopharma, Inc.는 종양학 회사로 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 독점적인 통합 무세포 단백질 합성 플랫폼인 XpressCF를 가능하게 하는 부위별 새로운 형식의 항체 약물 접합체(ADC)를 개발합니다. 및 사이트별 활용 플랫폼 XpressCF+. 주요 제품 후보에는 비소세포폐암, 두경부 편평세포암종, 자궁경부암, 대장암, 췌관선암종, 자궁내막암, 방광암 등 TF 발현 고형종양 치료를 위한 조직인자(TF) 표적 ADC인 STRO-004가 포함된다. 이 회사는 또한 성인과 성인 및 유아의 침습성 폐렴구균 질환 치료를 위한 2상/3상 임상 시험이 진행 중인 VAX-24 및 Vax-31 폐렴구균 접합 백신 후보를 개발하고 있습니다. 및 항수용체 티로신 키나제 유사 고아 수용체 1(ROR1)에 대한 ADC인 STRO-003은 삼중 음성 유방암, 비소세포폐암, 난소암뿐만 아니라 혈액암과 같은 고형 종양 치료를 위한 것입니다. Sutro Biopharma, Inc.는 치료용 백신 후보물질 발굴 및 개발을 위해 Vaxcyte와 협력 및 라이선스 계약을 체결했습니다.
